title: Yellowed British Baby Aubergine Gratin
description: A salty and gooey post-workout British dish featuring baby aubergine, soffritto-base, this halal-friendly recipe is perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the sliced baby aubergine to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
In a small saucepan, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the flour to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Slowly add the milk to the saucepan, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the grated cheddar cheese until melted.
Season the cheese sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Divide the cooked baby aubergine mixture among 6 individual mini cocottes.
Pour the cheese sauce over the top of the baby aubergine mixture in each cocotte.
